name: osis
description: OSIS 桥梁设计分析软件的 AI 插件：按真实 Python API 建模、改模型、跑计算，可同时操作本机多个 OSIS，也可不开界面只用求解器；模型三维预览里点选的对象可直接交给 AI 修改；内置常用桥型模板与建模技能，全程在本机运行。AI plugin for OSIS bridge design & analysis software: build and edit models and run analyses with the real Python API, across multiple local OSIS instances or headless with the solver alone; pick objects in the 3D model preview and let the AI edit them; built-in bridge templates and modeling skills. Runs entirely on your machine.

interface.shortDescription: 用 AI 操作 OSIS 桥梁设计分析软件 | Drive OSIS bridge design & analysis software with AI
interface.longDescription: 操作本机打开的 OSIS 桥梁设计分析软件，或不开界面直接启动 OSIS 求解器：查询 OSIS Python API，执行 Python 与 APDL 命令流，完成建模、修改与计算；在侧边栏或浏览器里查看模型三维预览，点选的对象可直接让 AI 修改。数据不出本机。Works with OSIS bridge design & analysis software open on your PC, or headless with the OSIS solver: look up the OSIS Python API and run Python or APDL to build, edit and analyze bridges; view the 3D model in the sidebar or a browser and let the AI edit the objects you pick. Everything stays on your machine. OSIS 官网 / Official site: https://www.osisbim.com/osis/home/
defaultPrompt: 帮我在侧边栏打开当前模型的快照 (Open a snapshot of the current model in the sidebar)
修改当前选中截面的偏心为底 (Set the offset of the selected section to bottom)
检查当前模型，修改材料参数后进行求解 (Check the model, edit materials, then run the solve)
